sections.label: Electrode placement
sections.description: One mark for each of the ten electrodes placed at its correct anatomical landmark first time, less any landmark hints you asked for.

sections.label: ECG analysis
sections.description: The rhythm and the systematic read of the tracing — rate, rhythm, P waves, PR interval, QRS, axis, ST segment and T waves.

sections.label: Clinical reasoning
sections.description: Putting the presentation, the observations and the ECG together, and choosing the appropriate next step.

bands.label: Excellent
bands.note: A clean, systematic run. Keep the same order of operations under pressure and it will hold.

bands.label: Strong
bands.note: Solid work. Read the debrief below for the points that cost you marks and try a new case.

bands.label: Developing
bands.note: The approach is there but the detail is not yet reliable. Work through the explanation, then repeat this difficulty until it is.

bands.label: Needs review
bands.note: Go back to the ECG module and the examination module for this material, then return to the simulation at Beginner level.
